kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-data-connectors --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1130916744880000 --data-connector-ids dc-1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8d10000 --data-connector-name SAS-CTDR-20260702100000 --sls-ingestion-job-name ingest-oss-dc-1a2b3c4d5e6f7a80000 --src-data-type s3 --data-connector-type s3 --dest-data-source-id ds-5sfe68t122pxnti1cjpl --data-connector-status enabled --page-size 1 --page-number 1 --order-field Id --order-type desc --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs0000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataConnectors

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center resides. Specify the management center region based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: The assets reside in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: The assets reside outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID that the administrator switches to when viewing as another member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en: The name of the Simple Log Service (SLS) data import job for the collector
parameters.help_zh: 采集器的 SLS 数据导入任务名
parameters.name: sls_ingestion_job_name

parameters.help_en:
The collector type. Valid values:
oss
s3
kafka
parameters.help_zh:
采集器类型，枚举值：
oss
s3
kafka
parameters.name: data_connector_type

parameters.help_en: The destination data source ID. This parameter is required only for synchronization
parameters.help_zh: 目的端数据源ID。（仅同步需要）
parameters.name: dest_data_source_id

parameters.help_en:
The collector status. Valid values:
"enabled": enabled.
"disabled" (default): disabled
parameters.help_zh:
采集器启用状态，枚举值：
"enabled" ：启用
"disabled"(默认) ：未启用
parameters.name: data_connector_status

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The sort field. Currently, only sorting by updateTime is supported. If OrderField is left empty, the default order returned by the database is used
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。
目前只支持按updateTime排序。
OrderField为空时，按数据库返回的默认顺序
parameters.name: order_field

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:
"asc": ascending order.
"desc" (default): descending order
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return when you use the NextToken-based pagination method. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 使用NextToken方式查询时，每次最多返回的结果数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request or if no more results exist. If more results exist, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token
